value: Logitech G HUB is running. Close it, then restart SimHub (G HUB claims the wheel and blocks force feedback).

SimHub is not running as administrator. This is required for reliable force feedback (the USB capture that mirrors the game's FFB can fail without it). Easiest fix: turn on 'Run as administrator' in SimHub's Settings, then restart SimHub.

Your wheel is connected, but FFB pass-through can't find it on the USB bus, so your game's force feedback may feel wrong or be silenced. This is most often fixed by restarting your computer: the capture driver only loads at boot, so a fresh install needs one reboot. Replugging the wheel or moving it to a different USB port can also bring it back. If that doesn't fix it, please use Report an issue with a log attached.
